subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI: declutter sidebar with customizable pinned nav and More section

question: Should the Control UI replace the fixed grouped sidebar with a customizable pinned navigation set plus a collapsed More section, and what should the default pinned routes be?
rationale: The current source has a fixed grouped navigation model with persisted group-collapse state; changing that default affects every Control UI user and needs product/UX intent before implementation.

options.title: Adopt pinned navigation
options.body: Implement pinned defaults, More, Settings-in-footer, topbar collapse control, local persistence, reset behavior, and visual proof.

options.title: Keep grouped navigation
options.body: Leave the current grouped sidebar and use existing group-collapse and recent-session collapse preferences for decluttering.

options.title: Narrow the polish
options.body: Move only the collapse control and Settings placement while deferring customizable pinned destinations.

recommendation.title: Adopt pinned navigation
recommendation.body: Implement pinned defaults, More, Settings-in-footer, topbar collapse control, local persistence, reset behavior, and visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant Control UI sidebar/topbar source lines and recent merged sidebar declutter PR point to `steipete`.
